title: Australian Keto Spring Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy keto bowl filled with Australian flavors, perfect for a spring day.

ingredients.name: Australian Wagyu Beef
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook to a safe internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.

ingredients.name: Spring Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of colorful spring vegetables, such as carrots, bell peppers, and zucchini.

ingredients.name: Avocado Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality avocado oil for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Coconut Aminos
ingredients.notes: A keto-friendly alternative to soy sauce.

ingredients.name: Chopped Fresh Herbs
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of herbs, such as parsley, basil, and mint.

ingredients.name: Keto Cheese Shreds
ingredients.notes: A keto-friendly cheese option, such as cheddar or mozzarella.

instructions: Season the Australian Wagyu Beef with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is cooking, toss the spring vegetables with avocado oil, coconut aminos, and chopped fresh herbs. Spread on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
To assemble the bowl, place a portion of the roasted vegetables on a plate, followed by a slice of the roasted beef. Top with keto cheese shreds and serve immediately.
